results.detail: no text detector configured; the qualified detector (Cloud Vision TEXT_DETECTION) needs a separate spend authorisation — source: pack_limits "… composite text deterministically."
results.source_text: Devanagari correctness criteria do not exist in Canon — never generate Devanagari glyphs; composite text deterministically.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Every key object has exactly one declared finish; two surfaces of the same tone still read differently by finish; no surface reads as both matte and mirror-glossy in one shot.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Highlight positions agree with the single implied source; highlight brightness does not fall off with implied source distance; a large soft source reads as a large reflection, never a hard point.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Shadow edge quality and highlight size agree — a soft shadow with a pinpoint specular, or the reverse, is a lighting contradiction.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: One nameable fictional source; key direction agrees with it; no shadow in frame contradicts the declared direction.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Product-to-ground tonal contrast survives a grayscale check; where depth planes are staged, nearer planes are darker than farther ones.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Mood is attributable to light character — direction, hardness, contrast — not to a brightness slider; the key level is declared and consistent across shots.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: State in one line what the hero image sells at a glance; if that line needs the body copy, the image fails.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Every specular on glass, dark or glossy surfaces is declared wanted or removed; none is accidental.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Count visible faces of the product; if a candidate angle shows more surfaces without breaking PA-D2 or PA-D5, prefer it.

results.detail: product_appearance not selected (trigger table: no product/packshot entity)
results.source_text: Every deviation from PA-D1..PA-D9 is listed in DOCTRINE_DEVIATIONS with its forcing brief clause; none is silent.

results.detail: read order and 'one dominant cue' need pixels and attention modelling
results.source_text: Name the 1st/2nd/3rd read; each carried by exactly one dominant cue; no two cues compete for one beat.

results.detail: placement zone and its reason need scene understanding in pixels
results.source_text: Placement is stated as a zone plus the reason for it; no placement is justified by a named ratio or grid line.

results.detail: edge treatment and tangency need pixels
results.source_text: The edge treatment is one of the three, named; no accidental near-tangency between a subject edge and a frame edge.

results.detail: framing-element tone/width comparison needs pixels
results.source_text: A framing element used is darker or thinner than the subject it frames.

results.detail: grayscale tonal weight needs pixels
results.source_text: Declared balanced or deliberately restless; if balanced, a grayscale check shows tonal weight agreeing with size weight.

results.clause: The stated aspect is justified by a named shape in the scene
results.detail: artifact 1024×1024 (ratio 1.0000) matches 1:1 (1.0000) within ±0.01
results.source_text: The stated aspect is justified by a named shape in the scene, not by the platform alone.

results.detail: CA-D7 is a video/image_sequence decision ('How does attention travel across cuts (video)?') — not applicable to static_image
results.source_text: Per cut, name the new information and motivation; per beat, state the one device: cut, camera move, or blocking.

results.detail: CA-D8 is a video/image_sequence decision ('When cut criteria conflict, what is sacrificed first?') — not applicable to static_image
results.source_text: An imperfect cut names the bottom criteria sacrificed; never sacrifice emotion for eye-trace, planarity or 3D continuity.

results.detail: CA-D9 is a video/image_sequence decision ('Screen direction and the line?') — not applicable to static_image
results.source_text: Screen direction and side-of-frame persist across consecutive shots, or something on screen shows the change (gos_0007), or the crossing is declared in DOCTRINE_DEVIATIONS.

results.detail: CA-D10 is a video decision ('How long may a shot hold?') — not applicable to static_image
results.source_text: No shot outlasts its describable content; the stated pace names the prevailing norm it assumes.

results.detail: CA-D11 is a video decision ('Does the camera move, and why?') — not applicable to static_image
results.source_text: Each camera move names its motivation; unmotivated moves are replaced by stillness or a cut.
